article.linkText: No. 19 Washington matches up against Utah State
article.story: Utah State (0-1) at No. 19 Washington (1-0), Sept. 12 at 3:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Washington by 26.5. Against the spread: Washington 0-1, Utah State 0-1. How to watch: BTN Key stats Washington Offense Overall: 402 yards per game (68th in FBS) Passing: 268 yards per game (54th) Rushing: 134 yards per game (89th) Scoring: 24 points per game (84th) Washington Defense Overall: 242 yards per game (45th in FBS) Passing: 142 yards per game (48th) Rushing: 100 yards per game (59th) Scoring: 10 points per game (38th) Utah State Offense Overall: 407 yards per game (67th in FBS) Passing: 245 yards per game (62nd) Rushing: 162 yards per game (70th) Scoring: 17 points per game (102nd) Utah State Defense Overall: 241 yards per game (44th in FBS) Passing: 152 yards per game (53rd) Rushing: 89 yards per game (50th) Scoring: 29 points per game (102nd) Utah State ranks 20th in FBS in third down percentage, converting 60% of the time. Utah State ranks 136th in the FBS with a -4 turnover margin, compared to Washington's 6th-ranked +3 margin. Both teams are heavily penalized. Washington ranks 137th in the FBS averaging 130 penalty yards per game, and Utah State ranks 122nd with an 83-yard average. Utah State is 96th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 75% of trips. Washington's red zone defense ranks 10th at 50%. Washington ranks 86th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 29:16, compared to Utah State's 36th-ranked average of 33:33. Team leaders Washington Passing: Demond Williams Jr., 268 yards, 1 TD, 0 INTs, 68.6 completion percentage Rushing: Williams, 61 yards on 7 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Chris Lawson, 87 yards on 4 catches, 0 TDs Utah State Passing: McCae Hillstead, 178 yards, 2 TDs, 3 INTs, 50 completion percentage Rushing: Javen Jacobs, 80 yards on 20 carries, 0 TDs Receiving: Eli Wood, 90 yards on 6 catches, 1 TD Last game Washington beat Washington State 24-10 on Sept. 6. Williams passed for 268 yards on 24-of-35 attempts (68.6%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball seven times for 61 yards and one rushing touchdown. Jayden Limar carried the ball 12 times for 47 yards and scored one touchdown. Lawson had four receptions for 87 yards. Utah State lost 29-17 to Idaho State on Sept. 5. Hillstead led Utah State with 178 yards on 15-of-30 passing (50.0%) for two touchdowns and three interceptions. He also carried the ball nine times for 43 yards. Jacobs had 80 rushing yards on 20 carries, adding four receptions for 27 yards. Wood recorded 90 yards on six catches with one touchdown. Next game Washington hosts Eastern Washington on Sept. 19. Utah State plays at No. 20 Utah on Sept. 19.
